question: This sign means that
picture: Blue circular sign with a white arrow pointing right

options.text: You must keep to the right hand side of the road.
There is a one-way street on your right.
You cannot proceed straight ahead or turn left.

question: This sign means that
picture: Blue circular sign with a white arrow pointing left

options.text: You must keep left to allow other vehicles to overtake.
You must turn left.
You must look out for traffic from the right before proceeding straight ahead.

question: This sign means
picture: Red circular sign with a white horizontal bar across the middle

options.text: No waiting.
No entry.
No stopping.

question: This sign means
picture: White circular sign with a red border and the number "50" in black

options.text: You cannot drive slower than 50 km/h.
You cannot drive beyond 50 km/h.
You must maintain your speed at 50 km/h.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangle warning sign with a black vertical road and a side road joining from the lower left

options.text: Slow down and beware of traffic from the left
Not slow down as you have the right of way
Stop and give way to traffic from the right and left

notes: None of the three options ends with a full stop in the source.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangle warning sign with a black road line curving to the right

options.text: Slow down and keep left as you are approaching a right bend.
Slow down and give way to oncoming traffic before turning right.
Slow down and get ready to drive up a steep slope ahead.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangle warning sign with two black arrows side by side, one pointing up and one pointing down

options.text: Not turn left or right but proceed in the directions as shown.
Make a U-turn ahead.
Keep left and beware of oncoming traffic.

question: This sign indicates
picture: Red triangle warning sign with two black horizontal arrows, the upper pointing right and the lower pointing left

options.text: Two-way traffic across a one-way carriageway.
Two-way traffic across a two-way carriageway.
You must turn right or left.

question: This sign means
picture: Red triangle warning sign with two black vertical lines, one straight and one with a bend

options.text: Road closed on one side - slow down, stop and make a U-turn.
Road narrows on one side - slow down and keep left, do not make a U-turn.
Lanes merging - give way to vehicles in the right lane.

question: This sign applies to
picture: Blue rectangular sign with white text "TOW AWAY ZONE"

options.text: All vehicles.
Motor-cars only.
Motor-cycles only.

question: This sign means that the road on the right is
picture: Blue square sign with a white vertical road and a branch to the right ending in a red bar

options.text: Leading to a military restricted area, you cannot enter.
Closed to all traffic, you cannot enter.
A dead end road, you may enter if you wish.

question: This sign means that
picture: Yellow and black diagonally striped board mounted on two posts

options.text: There is an army barrack ahead, drive in the direction as directed.
There is a barrier ahead, slow down and drive carefully.
The road is closed to traffic.

question: This sign means
picture: Red triangle warning sign with a black rounded rectangular outline enclosing a trapezoid shape

options.text: Tunnel ahead.
Expressway ahead.
A rear view mirror.

question: When you see this sign, you
picture: Red triangle warning sign with a black walking figure above dashed lines

options.text: Should slow down and be prepared to stop for pedestrians to cross the road.
Need not slow down if there is no pedestrian at the Crossing.
Should sound your horn to warn the pedestrians of your approach.

notes: Option B capitalises "Crossing" mid-sentence in the source.

question: These arrows marked on the road indicate that
picture: Overhead view of a two-lane road with white lane lines and curved arrow markings

options.text: traffic from the two lanes will merge into a single lane ahead.
all vehicles must either turn right or left ahead.
there are two bends ahead; one to the right and another to the left.

notes: Options begin with a lowercase letter in the source.

question: When you see these zig-zag lines by the side of a road, you should
picture: Overhead view of a road with white zig-zag lines along both edges

options.text: Slow down and keep left because the road ahead is narrow and winding.
Slow down and be prepared to stop for pedestrians to cross the road at the Crossing.
Drive carefully as the road is leading to an underground bomb shelter.

notes: Option B capitalises "Crossing" mid-sentence in the source.

question: This traffic light signal means
picture: Traffic light set with a full green light lit on the left and an amber right-pointing arrow lit on the right

options.text: All vehicles must get ready to stop.
Vehicles turning right must get ready to stop.
'Go' for left turn vehicles only.

question: This traffic light signal means
picture: Traffic light set with a full green light lit on the left and a red right-pointing arrow lit on the right

options.text: All turning vehicles must get ready to stop.
All vehicles must stop.
Vehicles turning right must stop.

question: When you see green traffic light signal from a distance, you should

options.text: Speed up.
Slow down.
Carry on at the same speed.

notes: Question reads "see green traffic light signal" (no article) in the source.

question: When approaching a traffic light junction with the amber light flashing, you should

options.text: Slow down and proceed across the junction only when it is safe to do so.
Speed up in order to pass the junction before the light changes.
Stop at the stop-line and wait for the light to change.
